jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a commodity management professional (f/m/d) you are the strategic procurement owner of the respective commodities within Gas Services Central Service Business. Role requires individual to develop and align a resilient Ecosystem strategy together with commodity circles and in line with global SE strategy and Global Service Operations (GSO & its Regions) objectives. Typical day for Commodity Management professional includes provide and demonstrate supply market knowledge beyond Procurement perspectives to generate value and impact, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, business case and sourcing strategy preparation/execution, reporting, problem solving, supply chain risk mitigation  as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. 

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Develop and execute Comprehensive Commodity Strategies (forward-looking) aimed at achieving business objectives (Growth, Resilience & Cost Out) for Global Service Operations & the Regions 
* Lead Cross functional Commodity Circle Team that embodies “Value Creation” mindset and drives improvements in cost, on-time delivery, quality, and lead times, while ensuring adequate capacity. The successful candidate will be the strategic leader for assigned commodities.  
* Provide strategic vision and represents their respective business interests into a global commodity team. Act as a role model for ownership, innovation, and transformation aligned with Siemens Energy’s values and strategy; Lead and develop assigned team members in commodity. 
* Works on commodity structure and provide periodic updates of commodity health to Strategic Procurement leadership and key customers, shares supplier market intelligence across Siemens Energy; Define and implement negotiation concepts and strategies to maximize savings; negotiate frame contracts and price lists 
* Supplier Management: Supplier selection, incl. documentation/onboarding and communication of strategic suppliers. Strategic evaluations, supplier classifications and supplier development to ensure an optimum supply chain.
* Handle relationships with strategic suppliers to ensure alignment with company demands, enabling early supplier involvement and driving cost-out initiatives; Identify procurement risks and opportunities through supplier market analysis and scouting, integrating findings into ecosystem strategies for continuous improvement of managed spend.

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree, or equivalent experience in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field; long term of work experience in the procurement area and a proven track record, ideally in a global organization
* Strong commercial and technical understanding and knowledge of procurement, project management, and international contract law
* Experience in functional leadership and project management is required
* Long term experience in multinational Procurement/ Supply Chain function
* Fluent language skills in English(primary) and German(secondary) language

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

* Verification of completeness, quality and timely availability of review documentation to enable equal access to information for all reviewers

•     Play a central role in process and production optimisation for industrial customers

•     Work closely with cross-functional teams and industry partners

•     Contribute to technologies that support the green transition

•     Share what you find - with engineers, production managers and machine operators alike

Who we are looking for

We are filling two positions and they do not have to be identical profiles.

Essential

•     A degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or equivalent

•     Real understanding of machining - the process itself, not just the theory around it

•     The ability to explain a technical result clearly to very different audiences, from design engineers to machine operators

•     Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is not a requirement

Advantageous

•     Specialisation in materials engineering

•     Hands-on experience with material processing and machining techniques

•     Strong analytical skills and experience with trial design, measurement or data analysis

•     Strong IT skills and familiarity with current engineering tools and methods

Ambitious recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you are early in your career we do not expect the experience - we expect curiosity and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

Eligibility. You must already be entitled to work in Denmark. We are not set up to handle work and residence permit applications, so we can only consider applicants who are citizens of the EU, EEA or Switzerland, or who already hold a valid Danish work permit.

What we offer

•     A high-technology research centre in strong growth, where you are invited to contribute both professionally and personally

•     Direct contact with our members and customers, and time spent inside companies most engineers never see from the inside

•     An innovative, supportive environment alongside highly skilled colleagues who share your interest in engineering

•     Work with technologies that drive the green agenda forward

Living in Herning

Interested in joining an international community in Denmark? Herning has a diverse expat network, and we will welcome you into it.

About DAMRC

DAMRC – Danish Advanced Manufacturing Research Center – is a leader in metal processing and is internationally recognised for ground-breaking innovation.

Our mission is to help Danish companies succeed through innovation and the use of the latest technology. We work in close collaboration with our members, which include several leading companies in metal processing and the machinery industry.

Since 2010 we have completed more than 400 industry projects.

We are a team of around 30 based at Industrivej Syd 17A, 7400 Herning, Denmark.

How to apply

We review applications as they arrive and will close the posting once we have found the right people, so there is no deadline — send yours when you are ready.

Send your application and CV to work@damrc.com with “R&D Engineer” in the subject line.

To hear more before applying, contact Rory Shaw (+45 2253 312/ros@damrc.com) or Sebastián Assain (+45 2222 5594/sea@damrc.com)

Your application and your personal data. We treat every application confidentially and process your personal data in accordance with the GDPR.

jobs.occupation: Experienced and reliable Aerated Concrete Installers
jobs.description:
Aerated concrete installer:
Laudal&Hansen ApS is a Danish construction company specializing in aerated concrete. With many years of
experience in the industry, we have built strong, long-term relationships with customers across most of
Denmark. Our projects range from multi-story buildings and private homes to high-end properties involving
custom and specialized solutions.

We are looking for experienced and reliable aerated concrete installers to join our growing team. If you
have experience with aerated concrete and are looking for stable work, good earning potential and a
professional working environment in Denmark, we would like to hear from you.
 

Your qualifications:
- Have experience with aerated concrete (AAC)
- Can read and understand technical drawings
- Can work independently and as part of a team
- Take pride in delivering high-quality workmanship
- Are reliable, flexible and solution oriented
- Have a valid driving license
- Can communicate in English
- Be an EU/EEA citizen or already hold a valid Danish work permit

We are offering:
- The expected monthly salary: approximately EUR 4,000-5,350, depending on performance, as the work is paid on a piece-rate basis
- 37-hour working week, with the possibility of overtime paid at the same rate.
- Salary is paid every two weeks
- Company vehicle for work-related use
- A room can be provided for the first three months, with access to a kitchenette and bathroom
- Freedom with responsibility and the opportunity to work independently
- We value respect, teamwork and good communication. We focus on creating a safe and positive workplace, both physically and mentally
- We support our employees in developing their skills and gaining experience across different types of construction projects

You are offered: Pension, health insurance and work clothes

How to apply: Please send your CV and application to info@laudalhansen.dk
